title: BUGFIX — generate-gate-report: mark views unverifiable when TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN absent
rationale: In scripts/generate-gate-report.ts, the total-views criterion always evaluates to pass: false when TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set, because manual-posts.jsonl entries have views=0 (no API fetch possible). This creates a misleading gate report that shows '0/500 views FAIL' when views simply cannot be fetched. Fix: detect TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN absence + zero views → mark criterion as 'unverifiable' (pass: null), exclude from overallPass logic, and suppress kill switch trigger. If token is present but views are genuinely 0, keep current behavior.

tasks.description: In scripts/generate-gate-report.ts: check process.env.TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN. If absent and totalViews === 0, set viewPass = null (unverifiable). Update criteriaResults to include pass: null. Update overallPass to treat null view criterion as non-blocking. Update kill switch to not trigger when views are unverifiable. Add note field to views criterion explaining why.
